cause: AimKill diagnostics existed only inside the game: reading them required opening the log overlay and copying text out by hand.
change: The payload now pushes its own AimKill log to http(s)://core-gmc.freefiremobile.com/okmod/aimlog on a host the 1297 PAC already routes to the proxy. The proxy addon answers 200 'ok' and appends one JSON line per report to logs/aimkill-online.log. Sends are rate limited to one per 3s, tagged shot / err / man, and fired on every AimKill result, on exception, and from the new GUI LOG button in the log overlay (next to COPY). Log line gained online=<state> sent=<count> tag=<last>.
transport: UnityEngine.Networking.UnityWebRequest.Get(url) + SendWebRequest(). The type lives in UnityEngine.UnityWebRequestModule (image 24 of the live metadata); claiming CoreModule would have rejected the patch the same way R11.90 was rejected.
verified: core_guard PASS 27/27, AimKill suite PASS, deploy health=200, service active, proxy sink round-trip selftest wrote logs/aimkill-online.log
